parole.significato: Any climbing vine of the genus Dioscorea in the Eastern and Western hemispheres, usually cultivated.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Portuguese inhame and Spanish ñame, likely from Wolof ñàmbi (“cassava”) or a related word. The term was spelled yam as early as 1657.
